messages:
noah: getting reports from two customers that high-priority alerts didn't page anyone. notify-connector logs show a bunch of `status=skipped` for outgoing pages around 11:47 UTC. starting triage.
ops-bot: automated alert: notify-connector queue depth spike > 300 for 60s (11:46:40 UTC).
noah: @tim-oncall can you confirm whether you got any pages? customers are in europe so might be region routing.
tim-oncall: I got an email but no pager page. I was in the channel but my phone never rang. not seeing incoming webhook retries in my oncall logs.
linda: looking at relay logs now — I see webhooks accepted from source-service, then a short-lived queue worker restart at 11:46:58. before restart, several items were marked `skipped` by `page-relay` with reason `dup-protection` which looks wrong.
mike: dup-protection? that usually applies to SMS dedupe. could be a header mismatch or our idempotency key parsing. grabbing raw payloads.
noah: paste any suspicious headers here. also check incident-bot handoff logs — we had a deploy yesterday for incident-bot rate limiter.
incident-bot: deploy-notify:incident-bot v1.12.3 rolled at 2024-06-11T09:02:14Z by @ci. Changes: outbound rate limiter + batching for webhooks.
linda: here's an example entry:
```
{"id":"evt_abc123","target":"pager+tim","headers":{"X-Request-ID":"r-456","Idempotency-Key":""},"status":"skipped","reason":"dup-protection"}
```
mike: notice Idempotency-Key is empty. looks like the connector started treating blank keys as identical and deduped aggressively after the worker restart.
noah: that would explain missed pages. why would key be empty? the generator service should set it. any recent changes upstream?
linda: found patch in source-service that trimmed header on null, introduced in PR #421. previously header omitted entirely, now empty-string header gets passed. page-relay dedupe logic treats empty string as a key and collapses items.
noah: ok immediate mitigation: disable dedupe in page-relay for any payloads with empty-key OR treat empty as missing. can we hotfix?
mike: I can lift a hotfix to fallback logic in relay: if `Idempotency-Key == ""` treat as absent. preparing patch now.
ops-bot: ops-runbook: notify-connector queue spike runbook started by noah.
noah: @tim-oncall start manual paging for any active P1s until we confirm replay. I'll coordinate replays.
tim-oncall: acknowledged. temporarily enabled manual pages for affected customers.
incident-bot: replay tool queued 98 items for reprocessing (ids visible in /replay/1718201234). starting replay with rate limit 10/s to avoid flood.
linda: mike's hotfix patch ready, rolling to canary now.
mike: canary shows no `skipped` for test payloads. rolling to prod in 2m.
noah: once prod patch is up, confirm replay finishes and manual pages can be disabled.
ops-bot: notify-connector prod rollout: relay v2.3.7 -> v2.3.8 at 11:53:18 UTC (canary ok). full rollout started.
linda: rollout complete. replay tool shows 98/98 processed, 95 delivered, 3 errored (retry queued). manual pages stopped.
tim-oncall: confirmed pages received for the three customers. phone calls came through. marking P1 as mitigated.
noah: customer impact: two enterprise customers experienced missed pages for ~7 minutes (11:46–11:53 UTC). mitigated by replay/manual pages. no data loss. we'll open a postmortem.
mike: root cause: change in source-service that began sending empty `Idempotency-Key` header; page-relay dedupe logic treated empty string as valid key and skipped messages. fix: treat empty string as missing; add validation in source-service and add alert when dedupe rate > threshold.
linda: action items: (1) postmortem doc (noah), (2) unit test + schema validation in source-service to reject empty idempotency headers (mike), (3) monitoring alert for skipped_count > 10/min (linda).
noah: assigning action items and will follow up. thanks all, great coordination. closing thread after PM triage scheduled for 16:00 UTC.
ops-bot: incident status: MITIGATED -> followup required. incident id: INC-20240611-17
